evidence_inputs.basis: judged only from the two rendered PNGs attached to the attached review run, magnified regions of those same PNGs, and the panel-drawing script at the reviewed head; no SVG and no other image was opened
evidence_inputs.marker_evidence: a blue-pixel blob scan of the limited PNG finds the axis triangle, the two legend swatches and no filled square in the plot area; the same scan finds the diverted X-point marker inside the wall
evidence_inputs.prior_defect: the blocking finding recorded at base 2ab0afa314d9 (oracle contours hidden beneath the route contours) no longer reproduces: the oracle is drawn at zorder 6 above the route at zorder 4 and the grey dashes are visible along every contour in both panels
evidence_inputs.provenance: the two attached PNGs are 1400x720 and are not byte-identical to results/limited-550-panel.png and results/diverted-550-panel.png in the reviewed run directory, so identity with the run's own preview files is not established by hash; the captions and rendered values match the reviewed run's manifest artifacts row for row (limited residual 9.64e-11, axis 1.16e-05, boundary 5.37e-06; diverted residual 1.59e-12, axis 1.05e-05, X-point 9.25e-06, boundary 2.59e-05)
evidence_inputs.writing: this review changed no file it reviewed

findings.summary: The fast-route boundary marker is not rendered. The only boundary mark in the panel is the hollow white-faced oracle square at the limiter midplane, and no blue filled square appears anywhere in the image, so the legend's 'fast boundary' swatch has no counterpart and a reader cannot see where the fast route places the limiter contact or agree it with the oracle's. That point is one of the two nulls the panel exists to compare, and it is the clause the caption reports as 5.37e-06 of span. The analytic root is outlined directly at render_panel.py:160-162, while the solved roots go through draw_nulls(..., contain=wall) at render_panel.py:171-173. The diverted panel, whose solved X-point lies inside the wall, does draw its blue marker, which isolates the difference to the limited row.

The oracle contour's white casing is wider than the fast-route contour, so wherever the two fields coincide the casing erases the route line and it renders as short blue dashes alternating with the grey dashes. The legend draws 'fast-route flux' as a continuous solid line, so the key describes a line the panel never shows; in both panels no blue contour is continuous. The agreement the figure conveys survives, which is why this does not hold the node, but the legend and the rendering disagree.
Several oracle dashes and route dashes terminate abruptly in open space inside the wall low on the right of the panel, at roughly three-fifths width and seven-tenths height.
